title: Leer's neodymium magnet treatment for Mitchell's knee implant
summary: Eric Mitchell tells of Leer's neodymium magnet treatment for Mitchell's knee implant, about recent at Eureka Springs, Arkansas, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: um my arm and Dr. Lear uh he thought maybe there wip might be one in my knee. It was like a weak signal. So he sent me a 100 lb neodymium magnet

plain: Eric Mitchell, a man who says he has had strange objects in his body, tells of a doctor named Roger Leer who studied such objects, which some people call alien implants. Mitchell says Leer picked up a weak signal suggesting there might be one in his knee, so Leer sent him a 100 pound neodymium magnet, a very strong kind of magnet, to deal with it at his place in Eureka Springs, Arkansas. If true, it would mean the thing in his knee reacts like a real physical object.
